FAQ
Common Questions
01
How does the AI Question Generator work?

Enter any URL and our tool analyzes the page to identify your industry, brand, and top competitors. It then generates 10 AI-ready questions across 6 categories: comparison, recommendation, how-to, features, problems, and pricing.

02
Is this tool really free?

Yes, completely free with no sign-up required. You can generate question sets for any URL instantly.

03
What data sources does this tool use?

We use real search volume data, keyword difficulty metrics, and live People Also Ask (PAA) questions from search engines to provide accurate, actionable insights.

04
How can I use these questions for SEO?

Use the generated questions as content ideas, FAQ sections, blog topics, or to optimize existing content for AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
